ValidationRule.description: Requires both Lost Comments and Reason Lost to be populated when Opportunity Stage = Lost.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Opportunity_Validation), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Standard_Opportunity", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Framework_Parent_Opportunity" ), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Lost"), OR( ISBLANK(IM_Lost_Comments__c), ISPICKVAL(IM_Reason_Lost__c, "") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please complete Lost Comments and Reason Lost before marking this Opportunity as Lost. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
